minimum_wage.note: National minimum wage from 1 January 2026, for a full-time month (Decreto 12.797/2025, art. 1).

inss_employee.note: CLT employee contribution from January 2026 (Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF 13/2026, art. 7 and Annex II; ceiling in art. 2). Each rate applies only to the part of the salary inside its band; the last limit is the ceiling. The exact sum is rounded once, as in the Receita Federal worked examples.

inss_contribuinte_individual.note: A partner's pro-labore paid by a company: the company withholds 11% (Lei 10.666/2003, art. 4), capped at the INSS ceiling (the last limit of inss_employee).

irrf_monthly.note: Monthly progressive income tax table from May 2025 (Lei 15.191/2025), still valid in 2026. The last bracket has no upper limit. The simplified discount replaces all legal deductions; the payer uses whichever gives less tax.

irrf_reduction_monthly.note: Monthly tax reduction from January 2026 (Lei 15.270/2025, new art. 3-A of Lei 9.250/1995), computed on the taxable income before deductions and capped at the tax from the table. Up to full_until the tax becomes zero; up to phase_out_until the reduction is constant - slope x income.

simples_nacional.note: Simples Nacional service annexes (LC 123/2006 as written by LC 155/2016). Effective rate = (revenue_12m x rate - deduction) / revenue_12m. Services of art. 18 par. 5-I go to Annex III when payroll / revenue >= fator_r_threshold (par. 5-J), otherwise to Annex V (par. 5-M).

dividend_withholding.note: From January 2026, profits above monthly_threshold paid by one company to one person in a month have 10% withheld (Lei 15.270/2025, new art. 6-A of Lei 9.250/1995). Whether it reaches Simples Nacional companies is disputed, so salary_core refuses to compute above the threshold.

labor_rights.note: Amounts owed on a CLT contract, used to estimate labor claims. FGTS is 8 % of pay (Lei 8.036/1990, art. 15) and the dismissal fine 40 % of all deposits (art. 18, par. 1). Overtime pays at least 50 % more (CF art. 7, XVI; CLT art. 59, par. 1); the hourly wage is the monthly salary / (30 x daily hours) (CLT art. 64), so with a 6-day week the divisor is 5 x weekly hours (220 for 44 h, 200 for 40 h, as in TST Sumula 431). The 13th salary and proportional vacation count 1/12 per month with at least 15 days (Lei 4.090/1962, art. 1, par. 2; CLT art. 146, more than 14 days); vacation adds one third (CF art. 7, XVII). Notice is 30 days plus 3 per year of service, up to 90 (Lei 12.506/2011), and counts as service time (CLT art. 487, par. 1). Late severance costs one monthly salary (CLT art. 477, par. 8). EC 141/2026 (DOU 2026-10-16) cut weekly hours to 42 from 2026-12-16 and 40 from 2027-12-16, added a second weekly rest day and exempted graduates earning at least 2.5 x the INSS ceiling, in force on publication; how the hourly divisor applies after it is not settled, so overtime is computed only up to overtime_computed_until.

labor_procedure.note: Limitation (CF art. 7, XXIX): a labor claim covers credits of the last 5 years before filing and must be filed within 2 years after the contract ends. Claims worth up to 40 minimum wages at filing follow the summary procedure (CLT art. 852-A).

internship.note: Internship stipend (Lei 11.788/2008): no mandatory INSS (art. 12 lets the intern join as a voluntary contributor) and no FGTS. The stipend pays income tax as income from work: the scholarship exemption of Lei 9.250/1995, art. 26, requires that no service is given in return.
